channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold eases amid firm US Dollar as CPI and Hormuz risks loom
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price registers modest losses on Tuesday, driven by a firm US Dollar as traders await the release of crucial US inflation data and the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. The rise in energy prices is also capping the yellow metal´s advance.

item.title: Fed’s Goolsbee: Inflation is the “biggest problem” of the economy
item.description: The Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee revealed in a video posted by Wired, that “The biggest problem facing our economy right now is not the collapse of industry and the collapse of jobs; it's that the prices have been rising too fast, we got an inflation problem and people hate inflation.”

item.title: Iran took back the Dow Jones Industrial Average breakout
item.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average broke the three-session coil that had pinned it beneath its record, traded up through 54,200, and has since surrendered the entire move.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Buyers struggle to clear the 21-day SMA
item.description: USD/CHF trades with a positive bias on Tuesday as the US Dollar (USD) consolidates its recent gains ahead of Wednesday’s US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data. Price action has stabilized above the 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) following a sharp pullback from above 0.8200 in late July.

item.title: Euro: Consolidation holds in mid 1.15s against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight that the Euro (EUR) is steady, extending a tight consolidation around the mid-1.15s after the Dollar’s late-July Fed-driven decline.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar remains under pressure as Middle East tensions support US Dollar
item.description: NZD/USD trades around 0.5880 on Tuesday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day with a 0.03% decline.

item.title: British Pound holds near 1.3500 as US CPI, UK GDP loom
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) holds firm against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday following the release of softer-than-expected US jobs data, while investors await US inflation data on Wednesday and UK GDP releases on Thursday. At the time of writing, the GBP/USD pair trades at 1.3508, nearly unchanged.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks and Fed path – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley discusses USD/JPY ahead of the United States (US) July Consumer Price Index (CPI) release, highlighting how softer US inflation could weaken the Dollar and lower the odds of another break above USD/JPY160.

item.title: Canadian Dollar holds firm against US Dollar ahead of US CPI
item.description: USD/CAD trades under pressure on Tuesday, staying on the back foot for a third straight day. However, the pair lacks follow-through selling as the US Dollar (USD) holds firm ahead of Wednesday’s US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA policy path caps upside against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux highlights ongoing pressure on the Australian Dollar after the RBA removed one projected rate hike, keeping the cash rate at 4.35% and projecting the policy rate around 4.40% through 2028.

item.title: EUR/GBP slips as bearish pressure mounts
item.description: EUR/GBP is trading on the lower end of its weekly range near the 0.8540 price zone on Tuesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Bullish momentum builds against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is supported by higher Oil prices and Friday’s strong Canadian jobs data versus weaker US labour figures.

item.title: Euro: Gradual appreciation path against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank's Chief Economist Dr. Jörg Krämer expects EUR/USD to recover once the Iran conflict eases and to grind higher over the coming quarters.

item.title: Gold pauses near two-month high as Oil swings shape Fed outlook
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) pauses its rally on Tuesday after hitting a two-month high of $4,435 earlier in Asian trading hours. Price action remains driven by movements in Oil prices and their impact on the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) interest-rate outlook.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Oil prices keep USD/JPY near 160 resistance - BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad explains USD/JPY has retraced half of its post-intervention drop, with US–Japan rate spreads already narrowing in favor of the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: Australian Dollar trades near weekly high after RBA decision
item.description: AUD/USD trades moderately higher above the 0.7060 price region after the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) left interest rates unchanged at 4.35% in a unanimous decision at the August monetary policy decision.

item.title: WTI Oil reverses course as Iran, Oman move closer on Hormuz talks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil retreats on Tuesday, trading around $80.40 at the time of writing, down 1.28% on the day. The US benchmark gives back its previous gains after Qatar reported progress in negotiations between Iran and Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA holds hawkish bias with steady rates – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner reports that the Reserve Bank of Australia kept rates at 4.35%, while Governor Michele Bullock delivered a hawkish message, stressing upside inflation risks and revealing that a hike was discussed. Short-dated Australian yields reversed higher.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Range-bound trade persists below 100-day SMA
item.description: EUR/USD fluctuates on Tuesday, holding within the range seen over the past week. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.1546, virtually unchanged on the day.

item.title: Gold: ETF inflows and sceptical outlook – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Carsten Fritsch notes Gold breaking above USD 4,400 per ounce despite a sharp Oil rally, with Fed rate expectations only modestly higher after weak US labour data.

item.title: Japan: BoJ inflation focus and rate risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank's Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley examines Japanese inflation dynamics and Bank of Japan policy. The report notes elevated Oil prices and supply risks, but stresses BoJ’s focus on core inflation and wage-driven pressures after decades of deflation.

item.title: Singapore: Strong growth momentum defies risks – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Chua Han Teng highlights that Singapore’s economy is set to deliver above-trend growth for a third straight year in 2026, supported by manufacturing, wholesale trade and financial services.

item.title: Euro: Rangebound against US Dollar as volatility sinks – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING observes that EUR/USD realised volatility continues to decline, with one-year volatility matching lows from November 2024.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Heading back toward 160 against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank notes that the Japanese Yen has weakened again above 159 per Dollar despite recent intervention and Bank of Japan signals.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles as impact of joint intervention fades
item.description: USD/JPY treads water on Tuesday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) struggles to find its footing, facing headwinds from a firmer US Dollar (USD) and elevated Oil prices. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 159.24 after hitting an intraday low of 158.92.

item.title: US ADP Employment Change 4-week average drops to 8.25K
item.description: Private-sector hiring in the US has further cooled in late July. According to the NER Pulse, the weekly companion to the ADP National Employment Report, companies added an average of 8.25K jobs per week in the four weeks ending July 25.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA softens hawkish stance – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) delivered a less hawkish hold, keeping rates at 4.35% and judging policy “somewhat restrictive” as the labor market has eased more than expected.

item.title: Silver retreats toward $65.00 as Oil rebound revives inflation concerns
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its correction on Tuesday and trades around $65.05 at the time of writing, down 2.31% on the day.

item.title: US Dollar: CPI keeps USD in tight ranges – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note the US Dollar (USD) softened as Fed hike expectations moderated and the US yield curve steepened.

item.title: Swiss Franc holds below 0.8100 US Dollar with US-Iran negotiations deadlocked
item.description: The Swiss Franc trades practically flat against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, consolidating halfway through last week’s trading range.
